esp32_gpio_touch_read.message0: 讀取觸摸原始值 · 引腳 %1
esp32_gpio_touch_read.tooltip: 讀取觸摸原始值. 功能取決於晶片及引腳。詳細參數與限制： Touch pins only; no pinMode needed. Values fall on ESP32 and rise on S2/S3/P4.

esp32_gpio_touch_threshold.message0: 判斷觸摸閾值 · 引腳 %1 · 閾值 %2
esp32_gpio_touch_threshold.tooltip: 判斷觸摸閾值. 功能取決於晶片及引腳。詳細參數與限制： Absolute raw threshold; comparison direction follows the chip. Measure idle and touched values first.

esp32_gpio_touch_calibrate.message0: 校準未觸摸基線 · 引腳 %1 · 採樣次數 %2
esp32_gpio_touch_calibrate.tooltip: 校準未觸摸基線. 功能取決於晶片及引腳。詳細參數與限制： Run in setup with the electrode untouched. Samples are clamped to 1–64.

esp32_gpio_touch_pressed.message0: 判斷相對觸摸變化 · 引腳 %1 · 百分比 %2
esp32_gpio_touch_pressed.tooltip: 判斷相對觸摸變化. 功能取決於晶片及引腳。詳細參數與限制： Calibrate first. Change is clamped to 1–90%; smaller is more sensitive. Release uses half the activation change for hysteresis.

esp32_gpio_touch_baseline.message0: 讀取觸摸基線 · 引腳 %1
esp32_gpio_touch_baseline.tooltip: 讀取觸摸基線. 功能取決於晶片及引腳。詳細參數與限制： Returns 0 before calibration or after failure. Recalibrate after electrode or timing changes.

esp32_gpio_touch_cycles.message0: 舊版觸摸時序（週期） · 測量時間 %1 · 間隔 %2
esp32_gpio_touch_cycles.tooltip: 舊版觸摸時序（週期）. 功能取決於晶片及引腳。詳細參數與限制： Legacy driver only: ESP-IDF below 5.5 and touch version up to 2. Use timing in microseconds on the new driver.

esp32_gpio_touch_timing.message0: 新版觸摸時序（微秒） · 測量時間 %1 · 間隔 %2
esp32_gpio_touch_timing.tooltip: 新版觸摸時序（微秒）. 功能取決於晶片及引腳。詳細參數與限制： New driver only: ESP-IDF 5.5+ or touch version 3. Set before the first touch read or interrupt registration.

esp32_gpio_touch_interrupt.message0: 監聽觸摸事件 · 引腳 %1 · 閾值 %2 · 執行 %3
esp32_gpio_touch_interrupt.tooltip: 監聽觸摸事件. 功能取決於晶片及引腳。詳細參數與限制： Actions run in loop; events may coalesce and include release. ESP32 uses an absolute threshold; S2/S3/P4 use an increment above the hardware benchmark.

esp32_gpio_touch_detach.message0: 停止觸摸監聽 · 引腳 %1
esp32_gpio_touch_detach.tooltip: 停止觸摸監聽. 功能取決於晶片及引腳。詳細參數與限制： Detach the callback and clear pending events; touch reads remain available.

esp32_gpio_touch_wakeup.message0: 觸摸深睡喚醒 · 引腳 %1 · 閾值 %2
esp32_gpio_touch_wakeup.tooltip: 觸摸深睡喚醒. 功能取決於晶片及引腳。詳細參數與限制： Configure wakeup without entering sleep. S2/S3 generally allow one touch wake channel. Combine with esp32_sleep.

esp32_gpio_adc_mv.message0: 讀取 ADC 毫伏值 · 引腳 %1
esp32_gpio_adc_mv.tooltip: 讀取 ADC 毫伏值. 功能取決於晶片及引腳。詳細參數與限制： Returns core-calibrated millivolts. Prefer ADC1 when using Wi-Fi on ESP32.

esp32_gpio_adc_average.message0: ADC 平均採樣 · 引腳 %1 · 採樣次數 %2 · 單位 %3
esp32_gpio_adc_average.tooltip: ADC 平均採樣. 功能取決於晶片及引腳。詳細參數與限制： Samples are clamped to 1–64. Raw range follows the ADC read resolution.

esp32_gpio_adc_resolution.message0: 設定 ADC 分辨率 · 位數 %1
esp32_gpio_adc_resolution.tooltip: 設定 ADC 分辨率. 功能取決於晶片及引腳。詳細參數與限制： Globally affects analogRead. Extra bits may be software scaling, not increased hardware precision.

esp32_gpio_adc_attenuation.message0: 設定全域 ADC 衰減 · 衰減 %1
esp32_gpio_adc_attenuation.tooltip: 設定全域 ADC 衰減. 功能取決於晶片及引腳。詳細參數與限制： Changes measurement range, not input voltage tolerance. Ranges vary by chip; never apply 5 V.

esp32_gpio_adc_pin_attenuation.message0: 設定引腳 ADC 衰減 · 引腳 %1 · 衰減 %2
esp32_gpio_adc_pin_attenuation.tooltip: 設定引腳 ADC 衰減. 功能取決於晶片及引腳。詳細參數與限制： Changes only this ADC pin. Apply global attenuation before per-pin overrides.

esp32_gpio_dac_pin.message0: 取得 DAC 通道引腳 · 通道 %1
esp32_gpio_dac_pin.tooltip: 取得 DAC 通道引腳. 功能取決於晶片及引腳。詳細參數與限制： Maps to ESP32 GPIO25/26 or S2 GPIO17/18. S3/C3/C6 have no DAC.

esp32_gpio_dac_write.message0: 寫入 DAC（0–255） · 引腳 %1 · 數值 %2
esp32_gpio_dac_write.tooltip: 寫入 DAC（0–255）. 功能取決於晶片及引腳。詳細參數與限制： Automatically enables true analog output; value is clamped to 0–255. No pinMode needed.

esp32_gpio_dac_voltage.message0: 設定 DAC 電壓 · 引腳 %1 · 電壓 %2
esp32_gpio_dac_voltage.tooltip: 設定 DAC 電壓. 功能取決於晶片及引腳。詳細參數與限制： Converts 0–3.3 V using a nominal 3.3 V reference and 8-bit DAC. Supply and load affect actual voltage.

esp32_gpio_dac_disable.tooltip: 停用 DAC. 功能取決於晶片及引腳。詳細參數與限制： Stop DAC output and release the pin.

esp32_gpio_pwm_quick.message0: 快速 PWM（百分比） · 引腳 %1 · 百分比 %2
esp32_gpio_pwm_quick.tooltip: 快速 PWM（百分比）. 功能取決於晶片及引腳。詳細參數與限制： Auto-attach at 1000 Hz / 8 bits on first use, then retain this library configuration. Duty is clamped to 0–100%.

esp32_gpio_pwm_attach.message0: 配置 PWM · 引腳 %1 · 頻率 %2 · 位數 %3
esp32_gpio_pwm_attach.tooltip: 配置 PWM. 功能取決於晶片及引腳。詳細參數與限制： Automatically allocates an LEDC channel. ESP32 supports 1–20 bits, others usually 1–14. Reconfiguration stops previous output.

esp32_gpio_pwm_write.message0: 寫入 PWM 原始佔空比 · 引腳 %1 · 佔空比 %2
esp32_gpio_pwm_write.tooltip: 寫入 PWM 原始佔空比. 功能取決於晶片及引腳。詳細參數與限制： Configure PWM first. Duty is clamped to 0 through 2^resolution−1.

esp32_gpio_pwm_percent.message0: 設定 PWM 佔空比百分比 · 引腳 %1 · 百分比 %2
esp32_gpio_pwm_percent.tooltip: 設定 PWM 佔空比百分比. 功能取決於晶片及引腳。詳細參數與限制： Configure PWM first. Converts using the current resolution and clamps to 0–100%.

esp32_gpio_pwm_read.message0: 讀取 PWM 配置 · 引腳 %1 · 讀取項目 %2
esp32_gpio_pwm_read.tooltip: 讀取 PWM 配置. 功能取決於晶片及引腳。詳細參數與限制： Reads configured hardware parameters, not an external waveform.

esp32_gpio_pwm_frequency.message0: 更改 PWM 頻率 · 引腳 %1 · 頻率 %2 · 位數 %3
esp32_gpio_pwm_frequency.tooltip: 更改 PWM 頻率. 功能取決於晶片及引腳。詳細參數與限制： Reattach this pin to avoid changing a timer shared by other pins; duty resets to 0.

esp32_gpio_pwm_tone.message0: 輸出方波（0 停止） · 引腳 %1 · 頻率 %2
esp32_gpio_pwm_tone.tooltip: 輸出方波（0 停止）. 功能取決於晶片及引腳。詳細參數與限制： 50% duty; auto-configures 10 bits. Frequency 0 stops the waveform. Low frequencies may exceed LEDC clock limits.

esp32_gpio_pwm_fade.message0: PWM 百分比漸變 · 引腳 %1 · 起點 %2 · 終點 %3 · 毫秒 %4
esp32_gpio_pwm_fade.tooltip: PWM 百分比漸變. 功能取決於晶片及引腳。詳細參數與限制： Configure PWM first. Hardware fade is nonblocking; do not change this pin PWM until it finishes.

esp32_gpio_pwm_invert.message0: 設定 PWM 反相 · 引腳 %1 · 反相 %2
esp32_gpio_pwm_invert.tooltip: 設定 PWM 反相. 功能取決於晶片及引腳。詳細參數與限制： Configure PWM first; useful for active-low LEDs.

esp32_gpio_pwm_detach.tooltip: 釋放 PWM. 功能取決於晶片及引腳。詳細參數與限制： Stops and releases the LEDC channel; the pin can be reconfigured or used for digital output.

esp32_gpio_pwm_ok.message0: 上次 PWM 操作成功
esp32_gpio_pwm_ok.tooltip: 上次 PWM 操作成功. 功能取決於晶片及引腳。詳細參數與限制： Reports this library last PWM setting operation; false on invalid settings or exhausted hardware resources.

esp32_gpio_pin_mode.message0: 設定引腳模式 · 引腳 %1 · 模式 %2
esp32_gpio_pin_mode.tooltip: 設定引腳模式. 功能取決於晶片及引腳。詳細參數與限制： Supports pulldown input and open-drain output. Open-drain HIGH releases the line and normally needs an external pull-up.

esp32_gpio_pull.message0: 設定上下拉 · 引腳 %1 · 上下拉 %2
esp32_gpio_pull.tooltip: 設定上下拉. 功能取決於晶片及引腳。詳細參數與限制： Changes pulls without changing direction. Classic ESP32 GPIO34–39 have no internal pull resistors.

esp32_gpio_drive.message0: 設定驅動強度 · 引腳 %1 · 驅動強度 %2
esp32_gpio_drive.tooltip: 設定驅動強度. 功能取決於晶片及引腳。詳細參數與限制： Sets drive capability, not regulated current; do not directly drive motors or other heavy loads.

esp32_gpio_hold.message0: 設定引腳保持 · 引腳 %1 · 操作 %2
esp32_gpio_hold.tooltip: 設定引腳保持. 功能取決於晶片及引腳。詳細參數與限制： Latches pin configuration and level. Restore the desired mode and level before releasing to avoid glitches.

esp32_gpio_deep_hold.message0: 設定深睡保持 · 操作 %1
esp32_gpio_deep_hold.tooltip: ESP32/S2/S3/C3 also need per-pin hold. C6/P4 use per-pin hold alone; this global block makes no change. Release each pin individually.

esp32_gpio_wakeup.message0: 設定淺睡喚醒 · 引腳 %1 · 電平 %2
esp32_gpio_wakeup.tooltip: 設定淺睡喚醒. 功能取決於晶片及引腳。詳細參數與限制： Configures level wakeup only. Set input mode and pulls first, then enter light sleep with esp32_sleep.

esp32_gpio_reset.tooltip: 重設引腳. 功能取決於晶片及引腳。詳細參數與限制： Release PWM, DAC, interrupts and hold first; restore the GPIO default configuration.

esp32_gpio_interrupt.message0: 監聽 GPIO 中斷 · 引腳 %1 · 模式 %2 · 執行 %3
esp32_gpio_interrupt.tooltip: 監聽 GPIO 中斷. 功能取決於晶片及引腳。詳細參數與限制： Set input mode first. Actions run in loop; edges may coalesce, so this is not a pulse counter. Mechanical buttons still need debouncing.

esp32_gpio_interrupt_detach.message0: 停止 GPIO 中斷 · 引腳 %1
esp32_gpio_interrupt_detach.tooltip: 停止 GPIO 中斷. 功能取決於晶片及引腳。詳細參數與限制： Detach this pin interrupt and discard pending events.
